description.value: Glow Gardens Langley is a large-scale outdoor Christmas light festival held annually from late November through December at a former greenhouse site in Langley, BC. Founded in 2017, the festival features over a million lights arranged in themed immersive lands, a Merry Makers Market with artisan vendors, gourmet food trucks, and live entertainment. Each year brings a new narrative theme — making it a destination-worthy seasonal attraction in the Fraser Valley.

raw_osm.description: Glow Christmas Festival sets out to create not just an event, but to bring families together and offer a magical experience celebrating the spirit of Christmas.
raw_osm.name: Glow Gardens Langley

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the business is a seasonal outdoor Christmas light festival. The FAQ page explicitly confirms on-site washrooms ('Yes, we will have bathroom and hand-washing facilities on site') and food trucks ('Gourmet food trucks offering mouthwatering culinary delights'). No cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, parking, pump, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content, and water bottle refill is not addressed.
concerns: Extremely seasonal: open only late November through December 31 each year, evenings only. Limited utility for general cycling tourism itineraries.
OSM opening_hours tag ('Dec Mo-Sa 16:00-22:00') lists only December, but the website confirms the festival opens in late November (Nov 20 in 2025) — OSM hours are incomplete.
No phone number available in OSM or on website.
As of site visit (May 2026), the 2025 season has closed; the 2026 season is announced for Fall 2026.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate tourist attraction but is highly seasonal — operating only approximately 6 weeks per year (late November through December 31) and exclusively in the evenings. No cycling-specific amenities are confirmed, making its value to the WWC directory marginal outside of a narrow holiday window.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wheelchair-accessible pathways (flat paved roads or hard-packed gravel) and accessible parking confirmed via FAQ. The festival has operated since 2017 and appears well-established with no closure risk.

Café or food on site.detail: Website lists 'Gourmet food trucks offering mouthwatering culinary delights' as a festival highlight

wow_evidence: Large annual Christmas light festival (over a million lights) — seasonal Nov–Dec attraction.
blurb: Million-light Christmas festival each November and December.
